plate_comment: Sets cold_delta_fuel (e2m 8A9F Cold_Delta_Fuel) from the e2m 8AA2 Cold_Delta_Fuel_Table by coolant temperature and filtered engine speed, or 0 while fault 16, 17 or 401 is detected (was cm848_calculateFuelDemandOffsetTrim)

While algorithm_enable_flags_40_cal bit 8 (e2m Misfire_Timing_Limit_Enable) is set, looks up injection_timing_main_misfire_limit (e2m 8A3D Misfire_Timing_Limit) from the misfire timing table (8A40 Misfire_Timing_Table) by boost pressure and filtered engine speed; it does no speed control (was cm848_processEngineConfigSpeedControl)
